description: bits-ui's Accordion of type single compiled from its published source (its options class hierarchy, the item's presence manager, the content's size measured through getBoundingClientRect into custom properties) through shadcn-svelte's unmodified accordion wrappers and the accordion-demo, accordion-borders and accordion-disabled demos, and an accordion bound to the app's string. Opened and closed by clicks and by Enter and Space on the focused trigger (pressing the open one closes it); arrow keys move focus through bits-ui's roving focus group (looping, skipping the disabled item), Home and End, Tab and Shift+Tab between accordions; set from outside through the bound value; onValueChange counts the accordion's own changes. aria-expanded, data-state, hidden content, the measured size, the chevrons, hover underlines and focus rings (pixel regions). The accordions mount when the app's Show button is pressed: bits-ui measures open content while it mounts, and Chromium lays text out with a fallback font until the app's font has loaded, after the app mounted (docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, web fonts while the app mounts). The content opens and closes with the site's animations (tw-animate-css's animate-accordion-down/up over shadcn-svelte's accordion keyframes and the measured --bits-accordion-content-height): bits-ui awaits the content's getAnimations() (running CSS animations as Animation objects, their finished promises settling at the frame the animation ends) before it hides closed content; frames are sampled mid-animation (the first 100 ms waits) and after it

knownGaps.geometry: Mid-animation frames: Stylo solves the content's ease-out timing function with an epsilon of 1/(200 x duration in seconds), 0.025 for these 200 ms animations, where Chromium's is 1e-7, so heights differ by up to about 2% of the content's height while it animates; settled frames match (docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, eased animations; with the epsilon at 1e-7 every gate passes)
